software.name: QCSchema
software.role: Standard JSON/schema contract shared by QCElemental and QCEngine.
software.notes: Not a standalone executable; exposed through normalize_qcschema_molecule and validate_qcschema_record using QCElemental models rather than a fake software runner.

software.name: QCElemental
software.role: Periodic-table data and QCSchema Pydantic models.
software.notes: Installed in the workflows runtime and exposed through typed QCSchema normalization/validation actions; it is also used by QCEngine.

software.name: QCEngine
software.notes: Execution substrate rather than a separate scientific result; NWChem public actions use its exact QCSchema harness, but no generic QCEngine workflow runner is exposed.

software.name: cclib
software.notes: Exposed as parse_quantum_chemistry_output for bounded parsing of Agent-supplied quantum-chemistry outputs; also installed in the TheoDORE runtime.

software.name: pymatgen
software.role: Materials structures, symmetry, and file-format data model.
software.notes: Exposed for crystal symmetry analysis, standardization, supercell construction, and explicit surface-slab enumeration.

software.name: spglib
software.notes: Exposed for crystal symmetry analysis and explicit conventional/primitive structure standardization.

software.name: MDTraj
software.notes: Exposed for contacts, dihedrals, radius of gyration, RMSD, SASA, secondary structure, and trajectory clustering; no propagation is hidden.

software.name: AiiDA
software.role: Provenance-aware workflow engine and data store.
software.notes: Profile researchchembench is initialized with SQLite under .software_cache/aiida and supports synchronous local run() with provenance. RabbitMQ is only required for daemon-backed submit/play/pause/kill and is intentionally not added to this bounded local benchmark runtime.

software.name: atomate2
software.role: Materials workflow building blocks on jobflow/pymatgen.
software.notes: Installed as a library only; no fixed workflow is exposed as a public Action.

software.name: jobflow
software.role: Composable jobs/flows and local execution primitives.
software.notes: A minimal add(2,3) local flow passed; Agent still chooses job ordering and inputs.

software.name: CENSO
software.role: Conformer ensemble sorting and thermochemical analysis executable.
software.notes: CENSO 2.1.2 uses an isolated configuration with ORCA 6.1.1, matching OpenMPI 4.1.8 and xTB; all electronic-structure stages select ORCA rather than the removed TURBOMOLE backend. A real two-conformer PBE-D4 prescreen completed. Production runs still require explicit ensemble, charge, spin, solvent and resource choices.

software.name: ORCA
software.notes: ORCA 6.1.1 and matching OpenMPI 4.1.8 with Fortran bindings are installed and validated by real energy, Hessian, optimization, dipole, SCF/relaxed-MP2/CCSD density, orca_2aim, MDCI cube-export, and large-system r2SCAN-3c/CPCM smokes. Typed density export rejects unavailable CCSD(T) one-particle densities and silent source substitution.

software.name: NWChem
software.notes: NWChem 7.3.1 is exposed for molecular energy, forces, Hessian, dipole, and Mulliken charges through QCEngine/QCSchema; official basis libraries are cached and a real HF/STO-3G water calculation passed.

software.name: GAMESS
software.notes: The registered 15 Jul 2024 R2 Patch 1 source was compiled with sockets DDI and OpenBLAS ILP64. Official optimization and public energy/dipole/optimization Action calls passed; the adapter accepts typed fields rather than arbitrary GAMESS input.

software.name: Gaussian
software.notes: Gaussian 16 Revision C.01 is staged in an isolated runtime. Public energy, Hessian, optimization and dipole calls passed; Hessians are reconstructed from formchk output and no arbitrary route deck is exposed.

software.name: autodE
software.notes: Library installed with NWChem support dependencies; no monolithic workflow Action is exposed.

software.name: geomeTRIC
software.notes: Exposed as optimize_geometry with component_backends.calculator; the Agent explicitly chooses the energy/force backend, method, constraints, trust radii, Hessian strategy, and convergence thresholds.

software.name: Sella
software.notes: Sella 2.5.0 is exposed for order-0 geometry optimization and order-1 transition-state search with an exact Agent-selected energy/force component; Hessian/IRC validation remains separate.

software.name: Multiwfn
software.notes: Official Multiwfn 2026.7.15 Linux noGUI package is exposed for explicit Mulliken/Lowdin charges, Mayer/Wiberg-Lowdin/Mulliken bond orders, and batch electron-isodensity surface areas/volumes from supplied wavefunctions or cube grids. Fixed version-specific menu sequences are used; arbitrary scripts are rejected and required citations are returned.

software.name: Critic2
software.role: Topological analysis of crystal electron densities and wavefunctions.
software.notes: Version 1.2.1081 is exposed for typed electron-density topology, basin integration, and Bader-charge actions over Agent-supplied density/wavefunction inputs and explicit partition/search choices.

software.name: GPAW
software.notes: GPAW 25.7.0 and PAW datasets are exposed for molecular/periodic energy, forces, stress, relaxation, band structure, DOS, and PDOS with explicit representation, PAW setup, k-point, spin, and convergence choices.

software.name: AIRSS
software.role: Random crystal-structure generation and explicit crystal-format conversion.
software.notes: AIRSS 0.9.3 is exposed through bounded candidate generation and cabal conversion Actions. Candidate generation does not run relaxation, choose an energy backend, deduplicate, or rank structures.

software.name: ACPYPE
software.category: Molecular Simulation, Free Energy, and Biomolecular Modeling
software.role: Explicit GAFF-family small-molecule topology generation and AMBER-to-GROMACS topology conversion.
software.notes: ACPYPE 2023.10.27 is exposed through separate topology-generation and conversion Actions; charge model, total charge, spin multiplicity, atom typing, charge program, output family, and conversion policy remain explicit.

software.name: SISSO
software.role: Explicit sparse symbolic-regression descriptor discovery, held-out evaluation, and bounded model parsing.
software.notes: Official version 3.5 commit bc18cae is compiled unchanged with the official-recommended Intel Fortran Classic 2021.2 and Intel MPI 2021.15 toolchain. Data columns, train/validation IDs, units, operators, complexity, SIS size, sparsifier, metric and resources remain explicit.

software.name: gplearn
software.role: Genetic-programming symbolic-regression baseline, explicit held-out evaluation, and cross-seed equation stability analysis.
software.notes: Version 0.4.3 is pinned. It has no supported CLI; the typed Actions expose its estimator without accepting executable Python or loading untrusted pickle/joblib files.

software.name: VASPKIT
software.role: Explicit VASP K-point mesh generation, crystal-symmetry analysis, and band-gap extraction from matching existing VASP outputs.
software.notes: Version 1.5.1 is downloaded locally from SourceForge. The bundled license prohibits redistribution without written permission, so migration requires a fresh official download. POTCAR data are not bundled or generated by the public Actions.

software.name: PyFrag
software.role: ORCA activation-strain analysis along explicit molecular reaction paths, plus bounded profile summarization and validation.
software.notes: PyFrag v1.0.0 commit af2a122d is patched only for Python 3 tokenization and ORCA 6 final-energy parsing. ORCA is a separate registered download and is not redistributed. Fragment partitions, reference energies, path, charge, multiplicity, keywords, and coordinate remain explicit.

software.name: BAGEL
software.role: Explicit SA-CASSCF and XMS-CASPT2 state energies, analytical nuclear gradients, and nonadiabatic coupling vectors.
software.notes: Version 1.2.2 source is paired with the Ubuntu 22.04 1.2.2-3ubuntu1 MPICH binary and its locally extracted runtime libraries. Active space, state manifold, target state pair, basis, convergence, CASPT2 shift/frozen-core policy and MPI layout remain explicit.

software.name: TDEP
software.role: Temperature-dependent effective force constants, thermal configurations, and phonon properties.
software.notes: Official tag 25.03 is exposed through separate force-constant fitting, canonical thermal displacement, and effective-phonon dispersion Actions. Every cutoff, ensemble choice, initialization source, and path control is explicit.

software.name: VASP
software.notes: Operator-provided VASP 6.3.2 is compiled with the isolated GCC/OpenMPI/ScaLAPACK/FFTW runtime. The supplied potpaw54 archive is cached with SHA-256 e987c9d8a0789bdeac2ff7d49fa26944145b9c363b81016ba25aac0d0e0c006f and indexed as five explicit families containing 735 exact variants. The Agent must choose every family/variant; no default POTCAR is selected, and the data must be treated as licensed and non-redistributable.

software.name: ShengBTE
software.notes: Official source revision b0d2090 is exposed as a calculate_lattice_thermal_conductivity backend for explicit CONTROL/FORCE_CONSTANTS inputs and RTA/iterative output selection; the real bundled Test-RTA returns 25.662 W m^-1 K^-1.

software.name: Wannier90
software.notes: Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 provides pw2wannier90.x. The conda Wannier90 3.1.0 binary reproducibly segfaulted after the initial state, so official v3.1.0 was rebuilt locally; the replacement completed a real four-band silicon workflow with final spread 4.037017340 Angstrom^2 and All done. Production runs still require task-selected projections, windows and convergence.

software.name: Yambo
software.role: GW/BSE and excited-state properties for periodic systems.
software.notes: Yambo 5.3.0 and p2y converted and initialized a real eight-band QE 7.5 silicon database. Typed GW and BSE Actions completed a minimal G0W0/BSE route and parsed quasiparticle and optical-spectrum outputs; production results still require explicit bands, cutoffs, k meshes and convergence studies.

software.name: LOBSTER
software.role: Chemical-bonding analysis of periodic electronic-structure results.
software.notes: LOBSTER 5.1.0 is exposed for periodic COHP/COOP/COBI bonding analysis, projected DOS, and projection-spilling quality checks over existing outputs; a real Quantum ESPRESSO diamond projection completed with 1.12% absolute charge spilling. No arbitrary lobsterin runner is exposed.

software.name: NAMD
software.notes: NAMD 3.0.2 AVX-512 and CUDA bundles are cached. The public atomic minimization/dynamics backend uses the validated CPU AVX-512 executable; CUDA remains unselected and untested because no GPU device is present.

software.name: AMBER
software.notes: AmberTools 26 is available in the OpenFF runtime. Licensed PMEMD26 CPU serial and MPI binaries were compiled and both public single-segment minimization/dynamics paths passed real tests; CUDA PMEMD is not built.

software.name: CHARMM
software.notes: CHARMM c50b2 was compiled as a serial/OpenMP GNU build. Typed minimization plus restartable NVE/NVT segment calls passed with explicit RTF/parameter/PSF/coordinate inputs; arbitrary CHARMM scripts are not accepted.

software.name: HOOMD-blue
software.role: Particle simulation engine with Python API.
software.notes: HOOMD-blue 7.1.0 CPU runtime is exposed for explicit force-field energy/force evaluation, minimization, and one dynamics segment in reduced units; a real CPU smoke passed.

software.name: pymbar
software.notes: Exposed for MBAR free-energy differences, thermodynamic expectations, convergence analysis, and explicit histogram free-energy surfaces; real synthetic multi-state tests pass.

software.name: alchemlyb
software.role: Alchemical free-energy analysis for MD trajectories.
software.notes: Exposed as parse_alchemical_energy_data for bounded GROMACS/Amber/NAMD alchemical reduced-potential or derivative data; estimators remain separate PyMBAR actions.

software.name: RMG-Py
software.notes: RMG-Py 4.0.0 is exposed for typed Arrhenius/MultiArrhenius/PDepArrhenius/Chebyshev rate evaluation and Wigner/Eckart tunneling factors. Full mechanism generation remains unexposed because it would hide database/model choices.

software.name: Arkane
software.role: Thermochemistry and kinetics from quantum-chemistry results.
software.notes: Shipped with RMG-Py and the official database. CoolProp 8.0.0 and numdifftools 0.9.42 repair the previous import timeout; the bundled H thermochemistry example now completes through Arkane and produces thermo, plot, and supporting-information outputs.

software.name: MESS
software.notes: MESS 2020.1.24 is exposed through solve_master_equation for an explicit native model and companions; the real HCO example returns structured finite-pressure and high-pressure-limit rates without automatic model construction.

software.name: MESMER
software.notes: MESMER 7.1 is exposed through solve_master_equation for an explicit XML model and companion layout; the real minimal H2O example returns structured first- and second-order phenomenological rates.

software.name: AutoMeKin
software.notes: Official source was built in an isolated conda environment with the bundled MOPAC engine; a real water PM7 single-point job ended normally. Gaussian is configured independently, but AutoMeKin-to-Gaussian/Qcore coupling is not prewired or selected implicitly.
